items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is emerging as a top AI infrastructure platform behind Nvidia. Click for this AMD update and see if it is the right stock for you.

items.summary: Anduril recently hit a $61 billion valuation, becoming one of the most highly valued private tech companies.

items.summary: Today's Research Daily features new research reports on 16 major stocks, including Apple Inc. (AAPL), KLA Corp. (KLAC) and Western Digital Corp. (WDC), as well as a micro-cap stock, Optex Systems Holdings, Inc (OPXS).

items.headline: A huge trade just happened on the Nasdaq 100. Bulls are taking notice
items.summary: Tech bulls may not have to wait much longer for fresh highs, if the single-biggest trade in the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF on Thursday is any indication.

items.headline: Oil prices fall 2% as mediators try to prevent U.S. and Iran from returning to war
items.summary: Oil prices turned lower on Thursday after the U.S. carried out fresh strikes on Iran, renewing concerns about supply disruptions in the Middle East.

items.headline: Kalshi traders see roughly 50% odds of a rate hike in 2026 as Fed is split on policy
items.summary: Wednesday's Fed minutes showed a divided outlook on where interest rates are headed this year. Traders on Kalshi see a 54% likelihood of a hike before 2027.

items.headline: Prediction markets spark insider trading concerns. Here's how Goldman and other companies are responding
items.summary: CNBC reached out to 50 companies about what are their trading policies for employees on prediction markets. A handful had an answer.

items.headline: Palo Alto CEO Arora says AI pricing needs to fall 90% as token costs skyrocket
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora said high token costs could prevent businesses from adopting artificial intelligence at scale.

items.headline: Trump claims to be 'No. 1' on TikTok. What does that mean?
items.summary: Trump is the most followed world leader on the app, with nearly 17 million followers.

items.headline: Action-starved traders look to small-cap stocks for the next big move
items.summary: One of the biggest options trades in the entire market Thursday seems to suggest small caps might lead the next move up or down.

items.headline: Alleged Reflecting Pool vandal David Hearn pleads not guilty; lawyer calls him 'scapegoat'
items.summary: "If Mr. Hearn can be charged with a felony for touching the Reflecting Pool, every American is at risk," a lawyer said as he blasted the Trump administration.

items.summary: Members of the trust advise Anthropic leadership and do not hold any equity in the company.
